## Fragment {#Sisk_Core_Helpers_UrlBuilder_Fragment}

Gets or sets the fragment part of the URL.

```csharp
public string? Fragment { get; set; }
```

### Property Value

[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)?

### Remarks

The fragment is the part of the URL after the [`null`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) character.
